old_value: {"id":"mimid-1wgh.14.6","title":"Agent sets ExternalPart.expires from the server's blob lifetime","description":"Follow-up of mimid-1wgh.14.2 (decision mimid-1wgh.67). mimid-server deletes every blob blob_lifetime_secs (30 days by default) after upload, but mimid-agent-core's Sealed::part sets ExternalPart.expires = 0 (mimi-content-10 §4.5: never). The server would need to advertise its lifetime (no JMAP or JMAP Chat MIMI field exists: INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC unless draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi gains one), or the upload response carry an expiry; then the agent sets expires to upload time plus lifetime, and the receiver already refuses expired parts (agent.rs fetch). Needs a decision on the field.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-11-19T18:46:48.815209964Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-11-19T18:46:48.815209964Z","labels":["agent","server","attachments"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"mimid-1wgh.14.6","depends_on_id":"mimid-1wgh.14","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-11-19T18:46:49.183508254Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
new_value: {"notes":"Mark 2026-11-19: spec field. jmap-chat-spec 120db2c adds account-level assetLifetime (UnsignedInt, optional, seconds after upload a blob stays at assetUrl); client MAY set ExternalPart.expires = upload time + assetLifetime. mimid: server advertises blob_lifetime_secs as assetLifetime (typed field once crate-jmap has it, asked of the crate-jmap session); agent sets Sealed part expires from it."}
